name: FAB402 Metal Fabrication
old_description: Our mission at FAB402 is to fabricate a wide range of custom metal products with emphasis on quality and service. We will never be content with our accomplishments of yesterday. We will always continue our drive to improve, adapt, develop, and be transparent.
about:
FAB402 Metal Fabrication operates from Lincoln, Nebraska, as a veteran-owned and operated shop. The company was founded with a mission to fabricate a wide range of custom metal products with an emphasis on quality and service, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication services including CNC cutting, 3D design, welding, cutting, shaping, and finishing—all performed under one roof. Capabilities extend to architectural metalwork, custom railings and staircases, vehicle modifications, prototype builds, equipment repair and modification, and metal business signs. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

FAB402 serves business-to-business clients across industries such as lawn care, construction, and home building, as well as individual customers. A noted project includes a custom dump bed built for Summit Lawns, a lawn-care company, while testimonials reference work for a woodworking business and a personal Jeep modification.

The company emphasizes continuous improvement, transparency, and a flexible partnership model that accommodates both one-time orders and long-term relationships. It positions contract fabrication as a cost-efficient alternative to in-house production, allowing clients to focus on their core operations.
